name: How long does crown molding repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does crown molding repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of crown molding repair varies based on the scope and complexity of the damage. Minor repairs, such as filling a few cracks or re-caulking a small section, might be completed within a few hours to a single day. More extensive repairs involving multiple damaged sections, custom cuts, or significant water damage remediation could take several days. We provide a projected timeline after our initial assessment, taking into account drying times for fillers, caulk, and paint to ensure a durable and high-quality result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to several days for extensive damage, including drying times for materials.
